plugins.name: travel-planner
plugins.description: Plan and price a whole trip from origin, destination and dates: researches flights, stays by neighborhood, cars, activities, day trips, buses and trains, restaurants, SIMs, transfers, weather and entry rules on the major booking sites, then builds a self-contained HTML dashboard with Budget / Mid / Upper / Luxury / Custom tiers, direct links and a map.

plugins.name: session-monitor
plugins.description: Live session monitor: network, CPU, memory and energy per command, clickable command output, a commit-by-commit git file and diff browser, and a project file explorer that makes, edits, renames and deletes files and folders.
